answer: Require each agent identity to post a small refundable bond and earn trust gradually. A newcomer may only make small trades until peers attest useful work over time, like a garden that yields only after steady tending. Crossing a ridge of rising limits unlocks larger trades, so each fake identity costs locked funds, waiting time, and lost deposits if fraud is flagged. A sudden gale of fresh accounts demanding high limits looks anomalous and can be throttled, while honest agents pay almost nothing beyond normal participation.
